name: nonogram-maker
description: Printable nonograms with one solution and an answer key.

interface.longDescription:
Make printable nonogram puzzles for teachers, students and puzzle fans as a PDF with an answer key. Zovo Nonogram Maker is a nonogram generator for griddlers, hanjie and paint-by-number logic puzzles: pick a built-in picture (heart, cat, rocket, crown and 16 more), spell a short word in block letters, paste your own pixel art up to 25 x 25, or ask for random grids from easy (10 x 10) to expert (25 x 25).

A line solver checks each puzzle before the PDF is made: it fills the grid from the row and column clues alone, one line at a time, without guessing. When it fills the whole grid, the puzzle has one solution. When a picture's clues allow more than one solution, you choose what happens: a few shaded starter cells are printed (the default), a few cells of the picture are changed and listed, or you get a message naming the unclear rows and columns so you can edit them.

The PDF puts 1, 2 or 4 puzzles on each page, on US Letter or A4, with clue numbers above and to the left of the grid, a thicker line after each 5th cell, an optional title and a name and date line. Answer pages at the end show the filled picture in the same place as each puzzle. Up to 12 puzzles fit in one PDF, and the same seed reprints the same puzzles.

In the chat you can try a puzzle by tapping cells, check your progress, and show the answer.

Limitations: black-and-white nonograms only (no colour nonograms), grids from 5 x 5 to 25 x 25, words up to 8 letters A-Z and 0-9, it does not turn a photo or image file into a puzzle, and titles print in Latin, Greek and Cyrillic letters (Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hebrew and emoji are left out of the PDF).
defaultPrompt: Make a heart nonogram and a cat nonogram, 2 per page, with answer keys, seed 7
Make 4 easy random nonograms for my class, 2 per page on A4, seed 12
Turn this pixel art into a nonogram: ..##.. / .####. / ###### / .#..#.

positive.prompt: Make a heart nonogram and a cat nonogram, 2 per page, with answer keys, seed 7
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_nonograms once with puzzles heart and cat, per_page 2, seed 7. The reply says the heart is 11 x 10 with 70 filled cells and the cat is 12 x 11 with 93 filled cells, each with one solution and no starter cells, and gives a 2 page PDF link (puzzle page and answer key page).

positive.description: Random set for a class on A4
positive.prompt: Make 4 easy random nonograms for my class, 2 per page on A4, seed 12
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_nonograms once with count 4, difficulty easy, per_page 2, paper a4. The reply lists 4 puzzles of 10 x 10 with 67, 62, 63 and 62 filled cells, seeds 12 to 15, and a 4 page A4 PDF with 2 answer key pages.

positive.prompt: Turn this pixel art into a nonogram: ..##.. / .####. / ###### / .#..#.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_nonograms once with the 4 rows as grid. The reply says an empty row was added to make the grid 6 x 5, 14 filled cells, 1 shaded starter cell printed so the clues give one solution, and a 2 page PDF link.

positive.prompt: Make a nonogram that spells LOVE, seed 3
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_nonograms once with text LOVE and seed 3. The reply says the grid is 25 x 9 with 58 filled cells and 7 shaded starter cells so the clues give one solution, with a PDF link and an answer key page.

positive.prompt: One hard 20x20 nonogram on A4, no answer key and no name line, seed 99
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_nonograms once with size 20x20, difficulty hard, paper a4, answer_key false, name_line false. The reply says the 20 x 20 puzzle has 224 filled cells and one solution, and the PDF is 1 page.

negative.description: Colour nonograms are out of scope. Expected: the tool is not called; the assistant explains this plugin makes black-and-white nonograms only.
negative.prompt: Make a colour nonogram with red, green and blue clues from my photo of a parrot

negative.description: Solving a puzzle from a picture is out of scope. Expected: the tool is not called; the assistant says this plugin does not read puzzle photos.
negative.prompt: Here is a photo of a nonogram from my puzzle book, can you solve it?

negative.description: Buying puzzle books is not this job. Expected: the tool is not called; the assistant answers without this plugin.
negative.prompt: Which nonogram puzzle books are popular this year?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.0: nonograms from 20 pictures, words, your own pixel grid or random grids up to 25 x 25, one solution checked by a line solver, 1, 2 or 4 per page, Letter or A4, answer key pages.

pl-PL.subtitle: Nonogramy do druku
pl-PL.description: Nonogramy do wydruku dla nauczycieli, uczniów i miłośników łamigłówek, jako PDF z kluczem odpowiedzi. Obrazek z wbudowanej biblioteki, krótkie słowo, własna siatka pikseli do 25 x 25 albo losowe siatki od łatwych do eksperckich. Solver linii sprawdza, że wskazówki prowadzą do jednego rozwiązania; gdy obrazek ma ich kilka, drukuje kilka komórek startowych, zmienia kilka komórek albo wskazuje niejasne wiersze. 1, 2 lub 4 łamigłówki na stronie, Letter lub A4, linia na imię i strony z rozwiązaniem.

de-DE.subtitle: Nonogramme zum Ausdrucken
de-DE.description: Nonogramme zum Ausdrucken für Lehrkräfte, Schüler und Rätselfans als PDF mit Lösungsseiten. Ein eingebautes Bild, ein kurzes Wort, eigene Pixelkunst bis 25 x 25 oder zufällige Gitter von leicht bis Experte. Ein Zeilenlöser prüft, dass die Hinweise zu einer Lösung führen; hat ein Bild mehrere, druckt es einige Startfelder, ändert einige Felder oder nennt die unklaren Zeilen. 1, 2 oder 4 Rätsel pro Seite, Letter oder A4, Namenszeile und Lösungsseiten.

es-ES.subtitle: Nonogramas para imprimir
es-ES.description: Nonogramas para imprimir para docentes, estudiantes y aficionados, en PDF con solucionario. Un dibujo incluido, una palabra corta, tu propio pixel art de hasta 25 x 25 o cuadrículas aleatorias de fácil a experto. Un resolvedor de líneas comprueba que las pistas llevan a una sola solución; si un dibujo admite varias, imprime algunas casillas de inicio, cambia algunas casillas o indica las filas dudosas. 1, 2 o 4 por página, Carta o A4, línea para el nombre y páginas de solución.

fr-FR.subtitle: Nonogrammes à imprimer
fr-FR.description: Nonogrammes à imprimer pour enseignants, élèves et amateurs de logique, en PDF avec corrigé. Un dessin intégré, un mot court, votre propre pixel art jusqu'à 25 x 25 ou des grilles aléatoires de facile à expert. Un solveur ligne par ligne vérifie que les indices mènent à une seule solution ; si un dessin en admet plusieurs, il imprime quelques cases de départ, modifie quelques cases ou signale les lignes ambiguës. 1, 2 ou 4 par page, Letter ou A4, ligne pour le nom et pages de corrigé.

ja-JP.subtitle: 印刷用のお絵かきロジック
ja-JP.description: 先生、生徒、パズル好きのための印刷用お絵かきロジック（ノノグラム）を、答えのページ付きPDFで作ります。内蔵の絵、短い単語、25 x 25までの自分のドット絵、または易しいからエキスパートまでのランダムな盤面から選べます。行ごとのソルバーでヒントから解がひとつに決まることを確認し、複数の解がある絵では、最初から塗ったマスを印刷するか、数マスを変えるか、あいまいな行を知らせます。1ページに1、2、4問、レターまたはA4、名前欄と答えのページ付き。

pt-BR.subtitle: Nonogramas para imprimir
pt-BR.description: Nonogramas para imprimir para professores, alunos e fãs de lógica, em PDF com gabarito. Um desenho pronto, uma palavra curta, sua própria pixel art de até 25 x 25 ou grades aleatórias de fácil a especialista. Um resolvedor de linhas confere que as dicas levam a uma única solução; se um desenho admite várias, imprime algumas casas iniciais, muda algumas casas ou aponta as linhas ambíguas. 1, 2 ou 4 por página, Carta ou A4, linha para o nome e páginas de gabarito.
